HOS means Hours of Service. These are th: HOS vle di Èdtan Sèvis. Se règ ki di konbyen tan ou ka kondui ak travay anvan ou dwe repoze.
ETA means the time we think you will get: ETA vle di lè nou panse ou ap rive.
POD means proof of delivery. It is the p: POD vle di prèv livrezon. Se papye oswa foto ki montre ou depoze chaj la.
BOL means bill of lading. It is the pape: BOL vle di bòdwo chajman. Se papye ki di sa ou ap pote ak pou kiyès.
CDL means commercial driver's license. Y: CDL vle di lisans chofè komèsyal. Ou bezwen l pou kondui yon gwo kamyon.
ELD means electronic logging device. It: ELD vle di aparèy jounal elektwonik. Se bwat oswa aplikasyon ki kenbe jounal kondui legal ou.
OTR means over the road. You drive long: OTR vle di sou wout la (over the road). Ou fè long vwayaj epi ou lwen lakay pou plizyè jou.
Hazmat means dangerous goods, like fuel: Hazmat vle di machandiz danjere, tankou gaz oswa pwodui chimik. Gen kèk wout ak tinèl ki pa pèmèt yo.
A reefer is a trailer or van with a cool: Yon reefer se yon trelè oswa kamyonèt ak frijidè ki kenbe chaj la frèt.
Bobtail means driving the truck with no: Bobtail vle di kondui kamyon an san trelè.
PO means purchase order. It is the numbe: PO vle di bon kòmand. Se nimewo expeditè a sèvi pou chaj sa a.
DOT vle di Depatman Transpò. Yo fè epi tcheke règ wout pou kamyon.
Type an address, a city, or a company na: Tape yon adrès, yon vil, oswa non yon konpayi. Peze yon rezilta pou wè wout la. Ou ka peze epi kenbe kat la tou pou chwazi yon kote.
